summary: Revalidated issue #194's own outstanding Ring-blocked cards now that issue #196's scan gap is resolved (WebP working-copy pipeline, issue #200). Published 7 already-wired cards (5 Rings, Moshi Ikako, Scholarly Hermit) as ring-wave-1/personality-wave-14/follower-wave-9. Found and fixed a real data bug: Moshi Ikako's own local catalogue stats were scrambled against a different record, hand-corrected against her scan. Revalidated Ring of Earth and Ring of Fire's own blocker notes (both based on mismatched scraped text, same class of problem as issue #195) and wired both fully with zero new primitives beyond a new any-province Target and reusing Chokehold's own enemy-personality-chi-lte-performer Target -- published in ring-wave-1 too (now 7 cards). Found and fixed a real correctness bug along the way per the user's own rules clarification: MarkDead was unconditionally routing every destroyed card to Zone.Dead regardless of type; only a Personality actually becomes dead, every other type now goes to its own ordinary discard pile -- this was already live-affecting three shipped cards (Furugaro, Unseen Assassins, Scholarly Hermit), all Follower self-destroys, whose own tests had encoded the wrong behavior as correct until now. Published count 256 -> 265.
validation: dotnet build (whole solution, 0 warnings/errors); dotnet run for L5R.Core.Tests (134/134, incl. 2 new RingOfEarth/RingOfFire tests and 5 corrected Zone.FateDiscard assertions), L5R.AI.Tests (13/13, byte-identical decisions/outcomes), 34/34 published tests, 8/8 deck-format tests; python3 -m unittest discover tools/collaboration (43/43) and tools/content (121/121).
